policy.scope: Text integrity, reading order, Markdown syntax and hierarchy, canonical rendered UI, and primary-text projection at the visual-owner serialization seam.
policy.source_grounding: The hash-bound source PDF is authoritative. LlamaParse remains the requested baseline, but generated descriptions, inferred values, and source-contradicted structure are not forced into parity.
policy.immutability: service-post-fix was not modified. Focused service and LlamaParse reruns were written to new sibling artifact roots.
policy.resolution_gate: A resolved user-visible discrepancy requires tests plus fresh JSON, raw Markdown, canonical Markdown, and rendered-DOM validation for the affected PDF.

resolutions.defect: Source-supported bold/italic scalar runs survived in JSON evidence but were omitted from raw/canonical Markdown; canonical UI flattened uniquely sourced headings to paragraphs and styled emphasis without semantic strong/em nodes or top-level item-type custody.
resolutions.source_truth: The rendered agreement visibly bolds the defined terms Agreement, Effective Date, Seller, Buyer, and Parties, retains the struck draft banner, and has explicit heading/subsection structure.
fix: Backend text-run projection serializes non-overlapping source-supported bold, italic, and bold-italic spans while preserving deletion/underline precedence and Markdown escaping.
Frontend projection mirrors the same strict graph and emits semantic strong/em nodes.
Canonical rendering emits a source heading at its exact validated h1-h6 level only when one contributor/item match is unique, and exposes authoritative data-item-type in canonical order.

before.rendered_assertion: 11 paragraphs; no heading, strong, or top-level data-item-type representation.

after.assertion: Final Markdown contains all five reviewed bold defined terms. DOM contains 17 source-backed strong nodes, three currently extracted heading nodes, and the complete 12-item canonical type sequence.

validation: Backend real-corpus P03-US05 regression: 10 passed with the absolute local Docling artifact root.
Frontend TypeScript, ESLint, and production vinext build: passed.
Fresh service JSON, raw Markdown, canonical Markdown, and rendered DOM inspected.
remaining_gaps: The struck Draft of 6/1/20 banner is still assigned a heading role.
Background is extracted at heading level 1 instead of its visible subsection level.
Later quotation glyph normalization differs from the baseline/source style.

resolutions.defect: The terminal visual-layout projection discarded an entire already-approved owner OCR ledger when one accepted line crossed the independently rounded source crop by less than one point. Public JSON became value-empty, raw/canonical Markdown showed a placeholder, and the rendered UI hid the source text.

source_truth.clinical-study: The accepted p3 flowchart OCR is visibly printed and independently retained in the owner OCR ledger. Its first line starts 0.898 point above the image crop; every other accepted line is inside.
source_truth.manufacturing-report: The accepted p1 chart labels are visibly printed and retained in the owner OCR ledger. The final -15.0% label ends 0.124 point below the image crop.

resolutions.fix: Already accepted, include_ocr_in_primary=true, same-owner OCR permits an inclusive 1.0-point margin only for pt-to-pt crop containment. More than 1 point, cross-unit geometry, foreign ownership, and include_ocr_in_primary=false remain fail-closed.
negative_gates: more than 1.0 point outside any owner edge
missing, rejected, or incomplete accepted OCR diagnostics

after.http_status: Both JSON and both Markdown responses were 200; all seven physical pages have rendered DOM captures.

clinical-study.assertion: p3-i2 value == md == ocr_text, source=ocr, detected/include true; 802-character OCR block occurs once in raw Markdown, canonical Markdown, and DOM; the external caption occurs once; placeholder absent.

manufacturing-report.assertion: p1-i2 value == md == ocr_text, source=ocr, detected/include true; 244-character OCR block including -15.0% occurs once in raw Markdown, canonical Markdown, and DOM; placeholder absent.

validation: Exact-profile clinical/manufacturing/Uber corpus slice: 3 passed in 57.07 seconds.
Uber classifier-unavailable photograph remained value-empty with diagnostic OCR excluded from primary Markdown.
Fresh HTTP JSON, raw Markdown, canonical Markdown, and rendered DOM inspected for both positive cases.

release_disposition: These two user-visible clusters are resolved and hash-bound. The consolidated release remains conditional because the per-PDF review retains independent text recovery, reading-order, heading-taxonomy, table, chart, and diagram gaps outside these resolutions.
